style: Cinematic, dark and monumental, photoreal with painterly murals, volumetric light, film grain, haze, embers. No logos, no emblems, no watermark, no caption, no identifiable faces - every figure in silhouette.

moments.title: Game 7 title in the arena
moments.prompt: Repaint the reference image keeping its composition, camera, lighting and materials exactly. Change only this: the words GAME 7 now hang in the air above the court, directly under the shaft of light and in front of the far basket - two enormous letters-and-numeral built like an arena marquee, three-dimensional, burnished dark metal with their faces lit from within in hot white-gold, throwing light down onto the hardwood and catching the haze. Embers drift around them. The painted murals on the walls stay as they are. Nothing else is written anywhere; GAME 7 is the only text.
